text:
ida kimball: Hey folks! 👋 I’m Ida — starting today as a Platform Engineer on the serving runtime team. Excited to be here. Quick Qs: which VPN profile do I use, who do I ping for MDM/laptop, and where do you usually stash onboarding checklists?

alex mccoy: Welcome Ida!! :tada: Great to have you. VPN is `redwood-vpn-prod` (connect with the Okta app). Ping @liz for laptop/MDM, and @jordan for infra access. Onboarding checklist is in Confluence -> Platform -> New Hires (I’ll paste a link in a sec).

liz (people-ops): Hi Ida — welcome!! I sent you an onboarding email with the voucher and MDM steps. If you didn’t get it, DM me. Typical timeline: MDM enrol + Okta SSO in the first day, then VPN and workspace permissions after we confirm your laptop.

jordan (eng-infra): Hey! I’ll handle GitHub org invites and CI access. Can you upload your SSH pubkey to your profile once you’ve set it up? Command: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ida@redwood.com"` then copy `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into the invite form. I’ll also add you to the k8s cluster viewer role.

ida kimball: Thanks — I see the people-ops email. Will run the keygen now. One more: where do people ask quick infra questions? is #eng-infra the right place or a ticket?

sam (devex): #eng-infra is fine for quick questions. For anything production-impacting open a ticket in Jira and tag `infra-oncall`. Also join DevEx office hours Wednesdays 4pm PST — folks drop quick tips there.

alex mccoy: For runbook stuff, start with the Platform Runbooks page. If you want a guided walkthrough, I can pair with you tomorrow at 10am PT.

todd (sre): Quick note on paging: you won’t be oncall for a few weeks but you can preview the oncall playbook here: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/oncall-playbook. If you want to test pager notifications, DM me and I’ll trigger a test.

onboard-bot: Reminder: New hire checklist assigned to Ida Kimball. Tasks: Accept benefits, Enroll MDM, Add SSH key, Join Slack channels. Due: 3 days from start.

ida kimball: Thanks all — appreciate the fast responses. Fun fact about me: I brew kombucha and I once took a 3-week coding roadtrip to hack on edge inference at coffee shops. Looking forward to meeting folks :)

alex mccoy: Love the kombucha — you’ll fit right in :smile: Coffee + latency jokes. I’ll drop the Confluence link and a short checklist in a follow-up. If anything blocks you today DM me.

jordan (eng-infra): Added you to the GitHub org and copied you on the invite email. If you want, post your laptop model and I’ll whitelist it for corporate WiFi.

liz (people-ops): Welcome again! We do a brief 1:1 with People Ops in week one to go over benefits and perks — I’ll put a calendar invite on your schedule.

ida kimball: Thanks everyone — joining #platform now. See you in the 10am walkthrough @alex.

sam (devex): Also, feel free to grab stickers from the office sticker rack when you’re here. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
